content:

title: Charges Laid - Saskatchewan RCMP / Corman Park Police Service Assist - Evade Police
content:
Members of the Saskatoon Police Service arrested a man who fled from a Corman Park Police Service officer early Friday morning.
On June 5, 2026 at approximately 1:20 a.m., Saskatoon Police received a request for assistance from the Saskatchewan RCMP regarding an incident near Martensville where a vehicle had evaded a Corman Park Police Service member during a traffic stop. The suspect vehicle reportedly fled southbound towards Saskatoon.
The Saskatoon Police Service Air Support Unit (ASU) began monitoring from above and was able to locate the vehicle travelling into Saskatoon at a high rate of speed. The vehicle continued driving in this manner for nearly an hour before coming to a stop in the 100 block of Avenue P South.
Throughout the occurrence, ASU observed the vehicle stop on numerous occasions and drop off passengers.
The lone remaining occupant of the vehicle, the driver, was arrested without further incident. A search of his person incident to arrest resulted in officers locating suspected methamphetamine. A search of the vehicle resulted on officers locating a baton.
As a result, the 31-year-old man has been charged with dangerous driving, possession of a weapon, possession of methamphetamine and breaching court-imposed conditions.
(Court Information Number: 991341283)
(Occurrence Number: 26-78511)

title: UPDATE: Charges Laid - Motor Vehicle Collision - Traffic Restrictions - 22nd Street East And 1st Avenue
content:
Saskatoon Police have arrested and charged a man with a number of charges relating to a stolen vehicle incident that resulted in a motor vehicle collision.
On June 14, 2026 at approximately 6:55 p.m., police received a report of a stolen vehicle. Police located the stolen vehicle approximate two hours later at the intersection of 22nd Street and Idylwyld Drive North where a high-risk traffic stop was conducted.
At this time, the vehicle’s owner also arrived on scene and attempted to remove the driver from the vehicle as police were conducting the traffic stop. The driver then began to flee in the vehicle; nearly striking a police officer. The suspect vehicle drove through a red traffic light where it struck another vehicle in the area of 22nd Street and 1st Avenue.
The driver of the other vehicle involved in the collision was transported to hospital by paramedics.
The driver of the stolen vehicle began to flee on foot but was located by officers shortly after. A Conducted Energy Weapon (CEW) was discharged and the man was arrested without further incident.
The 27-year-old female owner of the vehicle who attempted to remove the driver from the stolen vehicle was arrested at the scene of the collision and charged with Obstruction.
The 27-year-old man has been charged with Theft of a Motor Vehicle, Evading Police, Assaulting a Peace Officer, Impaired Driving and Breaching Court-Imposed Conditions.
Both the man and woman involved in this incident are believed to be known to one another.
(Court Information Number: 991342153)

content:

title: Charges Laid - Assault / Firearms Offence - 3300 Block Of 8th Street East
content:
Three people have been arrested and face a number of charges following an assault where a firearm was also involved on Saturday evening.
On June 13, 2026 at around 5:20 p.m., police received a report of an injured person outside a business in the 3300 block of 8th Street East. It was reported that there was a physical altercation and that security had detained multiple people.
Arriving officers located three security guards and four other people around them. Two youth males were arrested by police on scene and a search of one of the males resulted in officers locating bear spray.
A 20-year-old man was located with what were believed to be non-life-threatening injuries consistent with an assault. An uninjured 19-year-old woman was also located on scene.
Through investigation, officers learned two males approached another male and robbed him before a physical altercation occurred. It was also learned that, during the altercation, the woman reached into a bag and was believed to have pointed a firearm at the youth males.
The 19-year-old woman was arrested and a search of a nearby vehicle led to police to locating a sawed-off rifle.
As a result, two 16-year-old males have been charged with Robbery, Assault Causing Bodily Harm, and Committing an Offence While Masked. One of the 16-year-old males has also been charged with Possession of a Weapon, Carrying a Concealed Weapon, and Breaching Court-Imposed Conditions.
The 19-year-old woman has been charged with numerous firearms-related charges.
(Court Information Number(s): 991342098, 991342099, 991342100)
(Occurrence Number: 26-83191)

title: Arrest - CTSS Traffic Stop Leads To Charges
content:
A man is facing charges after failing to stop and assaulting a police officer following a traffic stop on Monday night.
Shortly before 8:00 p.m., June 15, 2026, a Saskatoon Police Service CTSS (Combined Traffic Service Saskatchewan) officer initiated a traffic stop on a vehicle for speeding on Highway 12 in the RM of Laird, SK. The driver was subject to a Mandatory Alcohol Screening test and registered a fail. Upon notification of this, the subject fled the scene. The officer followed the suspect to a residence in Waldheim, SK, and while attempting to make an arrest, the suspect assaulted the police officer. An RCMP member arrived on scene and assisted in taking the suspect into custody.
A 47-year-old man is charged with Fail to Stop, Resist Arrest, and Assault Peace Officer. He also was arrested on three outstanding warrants.
With funding from SGI, CTSS is an initiative designed to target distracted and impaired driving along with excessive speeding, in key areas of the province.

title: Charges Laid - Shooting - 3800 Block Of Fairlight Drive
content:
Members of the Saskatoon Police Service Patrol and Guns & Gangs Unit have charged a youth male with numerous firearms related offences following an investigation into a shooting that occurred last Friday.
On June 12, 2026 at approximately 7:50 a.m., police responded to a weapons complaint in the 3800 block of Fairlight Drive. Upon arrival, officers learned an unknown male had attended the residence and presented a firearm. It was also learned that bear spray had been discharged.
Through continued investigation, officers learned the male encountered another male at the entrance of the residence before a brief physical altercation occurred. During the altercation, the male that attended pulled out a firearm. At that point the male from the residence discharged bear spray at the other. The other male then fired a shot which struck the residence.
Both males then fled the scene prior to police arrival. There are not believed to have been any injuries as a result of this incident. Responding officers also located evidence that a firearm had been discharged.
Through further investigation, a warrant to arrest was issued for the male who discharged the firearm. As a result, a 17-year-old male was apprehended in Regina by Regina Police Service on his outstanding warrant.
The 17-year-old male has been charged with multiple Criminal Code firearms offences.
(Court Information Number: 991342148)

content:

title: Charges Laid - Stabbing / Assault - 200 Block Of Ells Crescent
content:
Two people were arrested and are facing charges following a stabbing late Saturday night.
On June 20, 2026 at approximately 11:55 p.m., police were called to the 200 block of Ells Crescent for a report of a stabbing.
Officers arrived on scene and located a 17-year-old male with what were believed to be non-life-threatening injuries. He was transported to hospital by paramedics. The suspect was an 18-year-old woman who was arrested on scene without further incident. While at SPS detention, officers learned she had an injury consistent with a stab wound. She was transported to hospital for further treatment.
Through investigation, officers learned another woman at the scene attempted to intervene in the initial altercation when a separate male at the residence assaulted her. The male was arrested without further incident.
All involved individuals are believed to be known to one another.
As a result, an 18-year-old woman has been charged with Aggravated Assault and a 17-year-old man has been charged with Assault and Assault by Choking.
(Court Information Number: 991342761, 991342766)
(Occurrence Number: 26-86657)

title: Evade Police/Injured Male - 100 Block Gibson Bend
content:
A 46 year old man is receiving medical treatment following an incident which occurred on the weekend.
At approximately 6:20 p.m. June 20, 2026, an officer was attending a call for service when he was approached by someone reporting a male acting suspiciously in the area of Evergreen Blvd. The person reported the male appeared to by trying to commit self-harm. As the officer arrived on scene he spotted a grey Hyundai Veloster leaving the area. As he followed, the driver began to operate the vehicle in an erratic fashion while waving his hands out the window. The officer along with a second unit, attempted to stop the vehicle, however it continued southbound on McCormand Drive before turning onto Brighton Gate and then into a parking lot in the 100 block of Gibson Bend. Upon arriving, officers spotted the unoccupied vehicle in the parking lot and located the male inside a store, where he was attempting to self-harm. A taser was deployed, allowing officers to provide immediate medical attention.
The male was transported to hospital.
(Occurrence Number: 26-87010)

title: Firearm Discharged / Stabbing - 400 Block Of Marlette Crescent
content:
Saskatoon Police are investigating an incident where a man was stabbed and a firearm was discharged over the weekend.
On June 21, 2026 at approximately 10:20 p.m., police were called to the 400 block of Marlatte Crescent for a weapons call where it was reported that a firearm had been discharged. Shortly after, police were called to the 3800 block of Kochar Avenue for an injured person call where it was reported that a male had been stabbed and a firearm was observed. It was believed the calls were related.
Officers arrived in the 3800 block of Kochar Avenue and located two people inside a vehicle, a 35-year-old woman and 28-year-old man. The man was transported to hospital with what were believed to be non-life-threatening injuries consistent with a stabbing.
Through their investigation, officers learned the victims met up with two people in the 400 block of Marlatte Crescent to sell a phone. A male and female suspect entered the vehicle and a short time later, a third male approached the drivers side window with a firearm. When the driver began to pull forward, the male in the back seat stabbed the man in the front seat. The male and female suspect then got out of the vehicle before the third male approached with a firearm and reportedly fired it before all three suspects fled the scene in a vehicle.
Members of the Saskatoon Police Serious Assault Unit are investigating in relation to this incident and anyone with information that may assist is asked to contact police at 306-975-8300 or submit and anonymous tip to Crime Stoppers at 1-800-222-8477.
(Occurrence Number: 26-87504)
